ui.sidebar.heading: CATEGORIES
ui.settings.title: ⚙️  Settings
ui.settings.language_hint: Changes apply immediately - no restart needed.
ui.settings.fallback_note: The command catalog isn't fully translated into every language yet. Missing text automatically falls back to German.
category.setup.label: Setup & Config
cmd.setup.benutzername_festlegen.title: Set username
cmd.setup.benutzername_festlegen.descrip: Sets the global Git username used for all commits on this machine.
cmd.setup.benutzername_festlegen.tip: Use --local instead of --global to set the name for a single repository only.
cmd.setup.e_mail_adresse_festlegen.title: Set email address
cmd.setup.e_mail_adresse_festlegen.descr: Sets the global email address attached to every commit.
cmd.setup.e_mail_adresse_festlegen.tip: Use the same email as your GitHub/GitLab account so commits are matched correctly.
cmd.setup.konfiguration_anzeigen.title: Show configuration
cmd.setup.konfiguration_anzeigen.descrip: Lists all currently set Git configuration values.
cmd.setup.konfiguration_anzeigen.tip: Add --show-origin to also see which file each value comes from.
cmd.setup.globale_config_bearbeiten.desc: Opens the global Git configuration file directly in the default editor.
cmd.setup.ssh_schlussel_generieren.title: Generate SSH key
cmd.setup.ssh_schlussel_generieren.descr: Creates a new SSH key pair (Ed25519) for secure, passwordless authentication.
cmd.setup.ssh_schlussel_generieren.tip: Add the public key (~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub) to GitHub/GitLab under 'SSH Keys' afterwards.
cmd.setup.standard_editor_setzen.title: Set default editor
cmd.setup.standard_editor_setzen.descrip: Defines which text editor opens for commit messages and rebase operations.
cmd.setup.standard_editor_setzen.tip: Replace 'code --wait' with 'nano', 'vim', or your preferred editor.
cmd.setup.standard_branch_name.title: Default branch name
cmd.setup.standard_branch_name.descripti: Sets the default branch name for new repositories (e.g. main instead of master).
cmd.setup.zeilenenden_normalisieren.desc: Controls automatic conversion of line endings (CRLF/LF) between the working directory and the repository.
cmd.setup.zeilenenden_normalisieren.tip: Windows users usually use 'true' here, macOS/Linux users 'input'.
cmd.setup.alias_anlegen.title: Create alias
cmd.setup.alias_anlegen.description: Creates your own shorthand for a frequently used Git command.
cmd.setup.alias_anlegen.tip: Popular aliases: st=status, br=branch, cm='commit -m', lg='log --oneline --graph --all'.
cmd.setup.git_version_prufen.title: Check Git version
cmd.setup.git_version_prufen.description: Shows the installed Git version - important for checking compatibility with newer commands.
category.basics.label: Basic Workflow
cmd.basics.repository_initialisieren.des: Creates a new, empty Git repository in the current directory.
cmd.basics.repository_klonen.title: Clone repository
cmd.basics.repository_klonen.description: Copies an existing remote repository, including its full history, to the local machine.
cmd.basics.repository_klonen.tip: Use --depth 1 to clone only the latest commit - much faster for large repos.
cmd.basics.status_prufen.title: Check status
cmd.basics.status_prufen.description: Shows changed, new, and staged files in the working directory.
cmd.basics.status_prufen.tip: This command is completely harmless - when in doubt, always run git status first.
cmd.basics.datei_stagen.title: Stage a file
cmd.basics.datei_stagen.description: Adds a specific file to the staging area, ready for the next commit.
cmd.basics.alle_anderungen_stagen.title: Stage all changes
cmd.basics.alle_anderungen_stagen.descri: Adds all changed and new files in the current directory to the staging area.
cmd.basics.alle_anderungen_stagen.tip: Be careful with generated files - a well-maintained .gitignore prevents unwanted adds.
cmd.basics.interaktiv_stagen.title: Stage interactively
cmd.basics.interaktiv_stagen.description: Allows staging individual chunks (hunks) within a file instead of the whole file.
cmd.basics.interaktiv_stagen.tip: Great for creating clean, topically separated commits.
cmd.basics.commit_erstellen.title: Create a commit
cmd.basics.commit_erstellen.description: Permanently saves the staged changes to the local history.
cmd.basics.commit_erstellen.tip: Write commit messages in the imperative mood ('Add feature' instead of 'Added feature').
cmd.basics.letzten_commit_korrigieren.de: Changes the most recent commit (message and/or content) instead of creating a new one.
cmd.basics.letzten_commit_korrigieren.ti: Never amend commits that have already been pushed and used by others.
Renames or moves a file while tracking the change in Git at the same time.
cmd.basics.datei_aus_git_entfernen.title: Remove a file from Git
cmd.basics.datei_aus_git_entfernen.descr: Deletes a file from the working directory and removes it from tracking at the same time.
cmd.basics.datei_aus_git_entfernen.tip: With --cached the file stays on disk but is no longer tracked by Git.
cmd.basics.anderungen_pushen.title: Push changes
cmd.basics.anderungen_pushen.description: Transfers local commits of the current branch to the remote repository.
cmd.basics.anderungen_pullen.title: Pull changes
cmd.basics.anderungen_pullen.description: Downloads changes from the remote repository and merges them into the local branch.
cmd.basics.anderungen_pullen.tip: git pull is equivalent to git fetch + git merge in one step.
cmd.basics.remote_hinzufugen.title: Add a remote
cmd.basics.remote_hinzufugen.description: Links the local repository to a remote repository under the name 'origin'.
cmd.basics.alle_anderungen_stagen_inkl_g: Adds new, modified AND deleted files across the whole repository to the staging area.
Difference to 'git add .': -A covers the whole repo, '.' only the current directory.
cmd.basics.stagen_und_committen_in_einem: Stage and commit in one step
Automatically stages all already-tracked, modified files and creates a commit directly.
Only works for already-tracked files - new files still need 'git add'.
cmd.basics.commit_ohne_hooks.title: Commit without hooks
cmd.basics.commit_ohne_hooks.description: Creates a commit without running any configured pre-commit or commit-msg hooks first.
cmd.basics.commit_ohne_hooks.tip: Useful for quick intermediate commits, but shouldn't become a permanent habit.
cmd.basics.bare_repository_erstellen.des: Creates a repository without a working directory - typically used as a central server endpoint.
cmd.basics.verzeichnisinhalt_zurucksetze: Discards all unstaged changes in the entire working directory and restores the last commit.
Equivalent to the classic 'git checkout -- .' - careful, changes are lost irrecoverably.
category.branching.label: Branching & Merging
cmd.branching.branches_auflisten.title: List branches
cmd.branching.branches_auflisten.descrip: Shows all local branches, marking the current one.
cmd.branching.branches_auflisten.tip: Add -a to also show all remote branches.
cmd.branching.neuen_branch_erstellen.des: Creates a new branch without switching to it.
Switches to an existing branch or commit.
checkout is a multi-tool - for pure branch switching, git switch is recommended today.
cmd.branching.branch_wechseln_modern.des: Safely and unambiguously switches to an existing branch.
Creates a new branch and switches to it immediately.
Equivalent to 'git checkout -b <name>' in the classic workflow.
cmd.branching.branch_umbenennen.title: Rename a branch
cmd.branching.branch_umbenennen.descript: Renames the current or a specified branch.
cmd.branching.branch_mergen.title: Merge a branch
cmd.branching.branch_mergen.description: Merges the changes from another branch into the current branch.
cmd.branching.branch_mergen.tip: On conflicts, Git marks the affected spots directly in the file content for manual resolution.
cmd.branching.merge_ohne_fast_forward.de: Forces an explicit merge commit even if a fast-forward would be possible.
cmd.branching.merge_ohne_fast_forward.ti: Preserves the information that a feature was developed on its own branch.
cmd.branching.merge_abbrechen.title: Abort a merge
cmd.branching.merge_abbrechen.descriptio: Aborts a merge with conflicts and restores the state before the merge.
cmd.branching.gemergte_branches_anzeigen: Lists all branches that have already been fully merged into the current branch.
A good basis for safely cleaning up old feature branches.
cmd.branching.branch_loschen.title: Delete a branch
cmd.branching.branch_loschen.description: Deletes a local branch, provided it has already been merged.
cmd.branching.branch_loschen.tip: Use -D to force deletion even with unmerged changes (careful!).
cmd.branching.branches_mit_tracking_info: Shows the associated remote branch and ahead/behind commit count for each local branch.
cmd.branching.nicht_gemergte_branches_an: Lists branches that have not yet been fully merged into the current branch.
cmd.branching.detached_head_auschecken.d: Switches to a specific commit without creating or updating a branch.
cmd.branching.detached_head_auschecken.t: Great for quickly inspecting an old state without affecting branch history.
cmd.branching.upstream_verknupfung_entfe: Removes the connection between the current branch and its remote tracking branch.
cmd.branching.upstream_nachtraglich_setz: Links an already existing local branch to a remote branch after the fact.
cmd.branching.squash_merge.title: Squash merge
cmd.branching.squash_merge.description: Combines all commits of a branch into a single change without creating a merge commit.
cmd.branching.squash_merge.tip: After the squash you still need to commit manually - the feature branch's history is lost.
category.history.label: History & Inspection
cmd.history.commit_historie_anzeigen.des: Shows the complete commit history of the current branch.
cmd.history.kompakter_graph_log.title: Compact graph log
cmd.history.kompakter_graph_log.descript: Shows a compact, graphical overview of all branches and commits.
cmd.history.kompakter_graph_log.tip: Great as an alias, e.g. git config --global alias.lg 'log --oneline --graph --all'.
cmd.history.log_mit_vollstandigem_diff.d: Additionally shows the full code changes for each commit.
cmd.history.log_nach_autor_filtern.title: Filter log by author
cmd.history.log_nach_autor_filtern.descr: Shows only commits from a specific author.
cmd.history.commits_pro_autor_zahlen.des: Shows a sorted overview of how many commits each author contributed.
cmd.history.datei_historie_uber_umbenenn: Tracks a file's history even across renames.
cmd.history.anderungen_anzeigen.title: Show changes
cmd.history.anderungen_anzeigen.descript: Shows all unstaged changes in the working directory compared to the last commit.
cmd.history.gestagte_anderungen_anzeigen: Shows the differences between the staging area and the last commit.
cmd.history.branches_vergleichen.title: Compare branches
cmd.history.branches_vergleichen.descrip: Shows all differences between two branches.
cmd.history.commit_details_anzeigen.desc: Shows full details and the diff of a specific commit.
cmd.history.commit_statistik_anzeigen.de: Shows only a summary of a commit's changed files, without the full diff.
cmd.history.zeilen_autoren_anzeigen.desc: Shows, for each line of a file, which commit and author last changed it.
cmd.history.zeilen_autoren_anzeigen.tip: Useful for quickly clarifying the context of a suspicious line of code.
cmd.history.log_mit_statistik.title: Log with statistics
cmd.history.log_mit_statistik.descriptio: Shows a compact summary of changed files and lines for each commit.
cmd.history.log_nach_zeitraum_filtern.de: Shows only commits created within a specific time range.
cmd.history.log_nach_zeitraum_filtern.ti: Also works with concrete dates like '2024-01-01'.
cmd.history.nur_dateinamen_im_diff.title: File names only in diff
cmd.history.nur_dateinamen_im_diff.descr: Shows only the names of changed files in a comparison, without content.
cmd.history.commit_nachrichten_durchsuch: Searches all commit messages for a specific search term.
cmd.history.code_anderungen_durchsuchen_: Finds all commits in which a specific code snippet was added or removed.
Extremely helpful for finding out when a specific function was introduced or removed.
cmd.history.wer_hat_wann_was_geandert_ku: Shows a compact one-line history together with the files changed in each commit.
category.stash_reset.label: Stashing & Reset
cmd.stash_reset.anderungen_stashen.title: Stash changes
cmd.stash_reset.anderungen_stashen.descr: Temporarily saves uncommitted changes and restores a clean working directory.
cmd.stash_reset.stash_mit_nachricht.desc: Saves changes to the stash with a descriptive note to make them easier to identify later.
cmd.stash_reset.stash_wiederherstellen.d: Restores the most recently stashed changes and removes them from the stash stack.
cmd.stash_reset.stash_wiederherstellen.t: With 'git stash apply' the stash entry is kept in case you need it again.
cmd.stash_reset.stash_inhalt_anzeigen.de: Shows the full diff of a stash entry without applying it.
cmd.stash_reset.stash_verwerfen.title: Discard a stash
cmd.stash_reset.stash_verwerfen.descript: Permanently deletes a specific stash entry without applying it.
cmd.stash_reset.datei_unstagen.title: Unstage a file
cmd.stash_reset.datei_unstagen.descripti: Removes a file from the staging area again without discarding the changes themselves.
cmd.stash_reset.soft_reset.title: Soft reset
cmd.stash_reset.soft_reset.description: Undoes the last commit but keeps the changes in the staging area.
cmd.stash_reset.hard_reset.title: Hard reset
cmd.stash_reset.hard_reset.description: Completely undoes the last commit and irrecoverably discards all related changes.
cmd.stash_reset.hard_reset.tip: Extremely dangerous - local changes are lost irrecoverably. Consider git stash first.
cmd.stash_reset.datei_wiederherstellen.d: Discards local changes to a file and restores the last committed state.
cmd.stash_reset.commit_ruckgangig_machen: Creates a new commit that reverses the changes of an earlier commit.
Unlike reset, revert is safe for already-pushed, public history.
cmd.stash_reset.stash_als_neuen_branch.d: Creates a new branch from a stash entry and applies the changes there.
cmd.stash_reset.stash_als_neuen_branch.t: Handy when a stash causes conflicts on a normal 'pop'.
cmd.stash_reset.alle_stashes_loschen.des: Irrecoverably removes all saved stash entries.
cmd.stash_reset.mixed_reset_standard.des: Undoes the last commit and removes the changes from the staging area, but keeps them in the working directory.
cmd.stash_reset.mixed_reset_standard.tip: The default mode of 'git reset' when no option is given.
cmd.stash_reset.bereinigung_testen_trock: Shows which untracked files 'git clean' would remove, without actually deleting them.
Always run this before the real 'git clean -fd' as a safety check.
category.remote.label: Remote & Collaboration
cmd.remote.remotes_anzeigen.title: Show remotes
cmd.remote.remotes_anzeigen.description: Lists all linked remote repositories, including their URLs.
cmd.remote.remote_anderungen_laden.title: Fetch remote changes
cmd.remote.remote_anderungen_laden.descr: Downloads new commits, branches, and tags from the remote repository without merging them.
cmd.remote.remote_anderungen_laden.tip: git fetch is always safe - it never changes your current working state.
cmd.remote.alle_remotes_aktualisieren.de: Fetches changes from all remotes while also removing stale branch references.
cmd.remote.branch_mit_tracking_pushen.de: Pushes a new branch and permanently links it to the remote branch of the same name.
cmd.remote.branch_mit_tracking_pushen.ti: Afterwards, plain 'git push' / 'git pull' calls are enough without further arguments.
cmd.remote.sicher_force_pushen.title: Force-push safely
cmd.remote.sicher_force_pushen.descripti: Overwrites remote history but aborts if foreign commits were added in the meantime.
cmd.remote.sicher_force_pushen.tip: Much safer than 'git push --force', since other people's work isn't accidentally overwritten.
cmd.remote.remote_branch_loschen.title: Delete a remote branch
cmd.remote.remote_branch_loschen.descrip: Deletes a branch on the remote repository.
cmd.remote.remote_url_andern.title: Change remote URL
cmd.remote.remote_url_andern.description: Changes the URL of an existing remote repository, e.g. when switching from HTTPS to SSH.
cmd.remote.remote_entfernen.title: Remove a remote
cmd.remote.remote_entfernen.description: Removes the link to a remote repository from the local configuration.
cmd.remote.remote_details_anzeigen.title: Show remote details
cmd.remote.remote_details_anzeigen.descr: Shows detailed information about a remote, including tracking branches and push/pull status.
cmd.remote.remote_umbenennen.title: Rename a remote
cmd.remote.remote_umbenennen.description: Renames an existing remote repository, e.g. from 'origin' to 'upstream'.
cmd.remote.remote_umbenennen.tip: Commonly used in fork workflows: 'origin' points to your own fork, 'upstream' to the original.
Downloads and merges only a specific remote branch instead of all configured branches.
With --rebase no extra merge commit is created and the local history stays linear.
category.tags.label: Tags & Releases
cmd.tags.tags_auflisten.title: List tags
cmd.tags.tags_auflisten.description: Shows all existing tags in the repository.
cmd.tags.annotiertes_tag_erstellen.title: Create an annotated tag
cmd.tags.annotiertes_tag_erstellen.descr: Creates an annotated tag with message, author, and date - ideal for version markers.
cmd.tags.annotiertes_tag_erstellen.tip: Annotated tags are preferred for releases since they store additional metadata.
cmd.tags.leichtes_tag_erstellen.title: Create a lightweight tag
cmd.tags.leichtes_tag_erstellen.descript: Creates a simple tag without extra metadata - essentially just a pointer to a commit.
cmd.tags.tags_zum_remote_pushen.title: Push tags to remote
cmd.tags.tags_zum_remote_pushen.descript: Transfers all local tags to the remote repository.
cmd.tags.tags_zum_remote_pushen.tip: By default, tags are NOT automatically transferred with 'git push'.
cmd.tags.zu_tag_wechseln.title: Check out a tag
cmd.tags.zu_tag_wechseln.description: Checks out the exact state of the repository at the time of a specific tag.
cmd.tags.zu_tag_wechseln.tip: You end up in a 'detached HEAD' state - create a new branch from there for changes.
cmd.tags.tag_loschen.title: Delete a tag
cmd.tags.tag_loschen.tip: Use 'git push origin --delete tag v1.0.0-beta' to also remove it from the remote.
cmd.tags.tags_nach_muster_filtern.title: Filter tags by pattern
cmd.tags.tags_nach_muster_filtern.descri: Lists only tags that match a specific name pattern.
cmd.tags.nachstgelegenes_tag_ermitteln.d: Describes the current commit based on the last reachable tag plus the number of additional commits.
cmd.tags.nachstgelegenes_tag_ermitteln.t: Result format e.g. 'v1.2.0-5-gabc1234' - great for automatically generated version numbers.
category.advanced.label: Advanced & Recovery
cmd.advanced.rebase_durchfuhren.title: Perform a rebase
cmd.advanced.rebase_durchfuhren.descript: Replays the commits of the current branch on top of another branch.
cmd.advanced.rebase_durchfuhren.tip: Never rebase branches that have already been pushed and used by others.
cmd.advanced.interaktiver_rebase.title: Interactive rebase
cmd.advanced.interaktiver_rebase.descrip: Allows editing, squashing, or deleting the last few commits.
cmd.advanced.interaktiver_rebase.tip: Perfect for creating a clean, readable commit history before a pull request.
cmd.advanced.rebase_fortsetzen.title: Continue a rebase
cmd.advanced.rebase_fortsetzen.descripti: Continues an interrupted rebase after conflicts have been resolved manually.
cmd.advanced.rebase_abbrechen.title: Abort a rebase
cmd.advanced.rebase_abbrechen.descriptio: Completely aborts an ongoing rebase and restores the original state.
cmd.advanced.cherry_pick.title: Cherry-pick
cmd.advanced.cherry_pick.description: Applies a single commit from another branch onto the current branch.
cmd.advanced.cherry_pick_abbrechen.title: Abort a cherry-pick
cmd.advanced.cherry_pick_abbrechen.descr: Aborts a cherry-pick with conflicts and restores the previous state.
cmd.advanced.reflog_anzeigen.title: Show reflog
cmd.advanced.reflog_anzeigen.description: Shows a history of all HEAD movements - the safety net for lost commits.
cmd.advanced.reflog_anzeigen.tip: The commit ID shown here can almost always rescue accidentally deleted commits.
Starts a binary search through the commit history to find the commit that introduced a bug.
Mark the boundaries with 'git bisect good/bad <commit>' - Git automatically suggests the next test point.
cmd.advanced.zusatzliches_arbeitsverzeic: Checks out another branch into a separate folder, parallel to the main directory.
Handy for working on an urgent hotfix without switching the current branch.
cmd.advanced.arbeitsverzeichnis_bereinig: Removes all untracked files and directories from the working directory.
Always run 'git clean -n' first as a preview - the deletion is irreversible.
cmd.advanced.notiz_zu_einem_commit_hinzu: Add a note to a commit
Attaches additional metadata to an existing commit without changing its hash.
cmd.advanced.leeren_commit_erstellen.des: Creates a commit with no content changes - e.g. to re-trigger a CI/CD build.
category.ignore_clean.label: Ignoring & Attributes
cmd.ignore_clean.gitignore_anlegen.title: Create .gitignore
cmd.ignore_clean.gitignore_anlegen.descr: Creates (or extends) a .gitignore file containing patterns for files to ignore.
cmd.ignore_clean.gitignore_anlegen.tip: For whole languages/frameworks, ready-made templates from github.com/github/gitignore are useful.
cmd.ignore_clean.bereits_getrackte_datei: Removes a file from tracking but keeps it locally - the .gitignore entry then takes effect.
Necessary because .gitignore only affects files that aren't tracked yet.
cmd.ignore_clean.verzeichnis_rekursiv_au: Remove a directory from tracking recursively
Removes an entire directory from Git tracking without deleting it locally.
cmd.ignore_clean.ignorierte_dateien_anze: Lists all files currently ignored by .gitignore rules.
cmd.ignore_clean.prufen_warum_eine_datei: Check why a file is ignored
Shows which .gitignore rule is responsible for a specific file being ignored.
Very helpful when debugging nested or conflicting .gitignore files.
cmd.ignore_clean.datei_als_binar_markier: Defines in .gitattributes that a file should be treated as binary (no line-ending handling, no text diff).
category.patches.label: Patches & Export
cmd.patches.diff_in_datei_exportieren.de: Saves all current changes as a patch file that can be applied later or elsewhere.
cmd.patches.patch_anwenden.title: Apply a patch
cmd.patches.patch_anwenden.description: Applies a previously exported patch file to the current working directory.
cmd.patches.patch_anwenden.tip: Use --check to verify beforehand whether the patch would apply without conflicts.
cmd.patches.commits_als_patch_serie_expo: Export commits as a patch series
Creates a separate, mailable .patch file for each commit, including commit message and author.
Classic workflow for mailing-list-based projects like the Linux kernel.
cmd.patches.patch_serie_anwenden.title: Apply a patch series
cmd.patches.patch_serie_anwenden.descrip: Applies a patch file generated by format-patch as a complete commit (including metadata).
cmd.patches.snapshot_als_archiv_exportie: Export a snapshot as an archive
Exports the current state of the repository as a .zip or .tar archive, without the .git history.
Great for sharing clean source code without version-control metadata.
category.submodules.label: Submodules & Subtrees
cmd.submodules.submodul_hinzufugen.title: Add a submodule
cmd.submodules.submodul_hinzufugen.descr: Embeds an external Git repository as a submodule in the current repository.
cmd.submodules.submodule_beim_klonen_lad: Clones a repository and initializes all contained submodules at the same time.
cmd.submodules.submodule_nachtraglich_in: Initializes and loads all submodules of an already-cloned repository.
Necessary when a repo was cloned without --recurse-submodules.
cmd.submodules.submodule_aktualisieren.d: Updates all submodules to the commit stored in the main repo.
cmd.submodules.befehl_in_allen_submodule: Run a command in all submodules
Runs any Git command in every embedded submodule.
cmd.submodules.submodul_entfernen.title: Remove a submodule
cmd.submodules.submodul_entfernen.descri: Completely removes a submodule from configuration, index, and working directory.
cmd.submodules.subtree_hinzufugen.title: Add a subtree
cmd.submodules.subtree_hinzufugen.descri: Adds a foreign repository as a fully integrated subfolder (an alternative to submodules).
cmd.submodules.subtree_hinzufugen.tip: Unlike submodules, other developers don't need extra commands to get the code.
cmd.submodules.subtree_aktualisieren.des: Pulls changes from the original repository into the embedded subtree folder.
category.hooks.label: Hooks & Automation
cmd.hooks.hook_verzeichnis_anzeigen.desc: Lists all available (sample) hooks in the local repository.
cmd.hooks.hook_verzeichnis_anzeigen.tip: Git ships a '.sample' file for every hook, serving as a template.
cmd.hooks.pre_commit_hook_aktivieren.des: Enables a hook that runs automatically before every commit (e.g. for linting/tests).
cmd.hooks.pre_commit_hook_aktivieren.tip: The hook must be an executable script with no file extension under exactly this name.
cmd.hooks.globales_hook_verzeichnis_setz: Defines a central, project-wide directory for Git hooks.
Handy for providing team-wide hooks under version control instead of copying them per repo.
cmd.hooks.commit_vorlage_einrichten.desc: Sets a default template that is automatically loaded as starting text for every 'git commit'.
category.maintenance.label: Maintenance & Performance
cmd.maintenance.repository_optimieren.de: Compresses loose objects and optimizes the repository's internal storage structure.
cmd.maintenance.repository_optimieren.ti: --aggressive optimizes more thoroughly but much slower - the default mode is usually enough.
cmd.maintenance.repository_integritat_pr: Checks the consistency of all objects and links in the repository for corruption.
cmd.maintenance.objektanzahl_anzeigen.de: Shows the number and storage size of loose Git objects in the repository.
cmd.maintenance.nicht_erreichbare_objekt: Permanently removes all objects no longer referenced by any branch/tag.
Affects, for example, commits orphaned by 'git reset --hard' or deleted branches.
cmd.maintenance.partielles_auschecken_sp: Checks out only selected folders of a large repository instead of the entire directory tree.
Significantly speeds up work with huge monorepos.
cmd.maintenance.flachen_klon_nachtraglic: Fully downloads the missing history of a shallow clone created with --depth 1.
category.lfs.label: Git LFS (Large Files)
cmd.lfs.git_lfs_aktivieren.title: Enable Git LFS
cmd.lfs.git_lfs_aktivieren.description: Initializes Git Large File Storage for the current repository.
cmd.lfs.git_lfs_aktivieren.tip: Requires the separate 'git-lfs' package to be installed on the system.
cmd.lfs.dateityp_per_lfs_verwalten.title: Manage a file type via LFS
cmd.lfs.dateityp_per_lfs_verwalten.descr: Marks a file type to be stored via Git LFS instead of directly in the repository.
cmd.lfs.dateityp_per_lfs_verwalten.tip: The rules automatically end up in the .gitattributes file, which must be committed.
cmd.lfs.lfs_dateien_auflisten.title: List LFS files
cmd.lfs.lfs_dateien_auflisten.descriptio: Shows all files in the repository currently managed by Git LFS.
cmd.lfs.lfs_inhalte_nachladen.title: Download LFS content
cmd.lfs.lfs_inhalte_nachladen.descriptio: Downloads the actual binary content of LFS-managed files from the server.
cmd.lfs.lfs_inhalte_nachladen.tip: Without this command, LFS files initially contain only small pointer files after a clone.
category.specialtools.label: Special Tools (Porcelain)
cmd.specialtools.code_inhalt_durchsuchen: Searches the content of all tracked files (optionally at a specific commit) for a search pattern.
Add --line-number to also show line numbers; also works on old commits: git grep 'x' <commit>.
cmd.specialtools.konfliktlosungen_merken: Records a manually resolved merge conflict once and automatically reapplies the same resolution.
Extremely useful for frequent rebases over the same conflict spots.
cmd.specialtools.repository_als_datei_bu: Packs the entire repository (or part of it) into a single, transportable file.
Great for transferring via USB stick or email when there's no network access to a remote.
cmd.specialtools.aus_einem_bundle_klonen: Creates a complete repository from a file previously created with 'git bundle'.
cmd.specialtools.alle_arbeitsverzeichnis: Shows all additional working directories created with 'git worktree add'.
cmd.specialtools.arbeitsverzeichnis_entf: Cleanly removes a previously created additional working directory from management.
Use 'git worktree prune' to clean up orphaned entries after manually deleting the folder.
cmd.specialtools.commit_serien_vergleich: Compares two versions of the same commit series, e.g. before and after an interactive rebase.
Shows which commits actually changed content - much more precise than a normal diff.
cmd.specialtools.commit_graph_datei_erze: Creates an optimized graph file that speeds up 'git log' and history queries in large repos.
cmd.specialtools.automatische_wartung_ei: Sets up recurring background maintenance tasks (gc, commit-graph, prefetch).
A modern replacement for manually recurring 'git gc' calls.
Verifies the GPG or SSH signature of a signed commit.
cmd.specialtools.tag_signatur_prufen.des: Verifies the GPG signature of a signed, annotated tag.
cmd.specialtools.signierten_commit_erste: Creates a commit that is additionally cryptographically signed with the configured GPG/SSH key.
Use 'git config --global commit.gpgsign true' to enforce signing globally.
cmd.specialtools.objekt_temporar_ersetze: Replaces an object (e.g. a broken commit) with another one, without rewriting history.
Used, for example, to make sensitive data in old commits 'invisible' without changing hashes.
cmd.specialtools.historie_mit_filter_rep: Permanently removes a file (e.g. accidentally committed credentials) from the entire history.
Requires the separate 'git-filter-repo' tool; replaces the deprecated built-in 'git filter-branch'.
Runs the binary bug search fully automatically using a test script that reports success/failure.
The script must return exit code 0 on success and non-zero on failure.
cmd.specialtools.pull_request_text_gener: Creates a formatted summary of a branch's commits, ideal for sending a pull request by email.
cmd.specialtools.grafische_historie_offn: Opens the bundled graphical interface for visualizing the commit history.
'git gui' is also available for a graphical commit workflow.
cmd.specialtools.zugangsdaten_zwischensp: Temporarily stores HTTPS credentials in memory to avoid repeated password prompts.
On Linux use 'libsecret', on macOS 'osxkeychain', on Windows 'manager' as an alternative helper.
category.plumbing.label: Plumbing / Low-Level
cmd.plumbing.objekt_inhalt_anzeigen.desc: Shows the raw content, type, or size of any Git object based on its hash.
cmd.plumbing.objekt_inhalt_anzeigen.tip: Use -t to show only the object type (blob/tree/commit/tag), -s for only the size.
cmd.plumbing.blob_objekt_erzeugen.title: Create a blob object
cmd.plumbing.blob_objekt_erzeugen.descri: Computes a file's SHA hash and optionally stores it as a blob object in the object database.
cmd.plumbing.blob_objekt_erzeugen.tip: This exact mechanism is what every 'git add' relies on internally.
cmd.plumbing.verzeichnisbaum_anzeigen.de: Lists the content of a tree object - the internal representation of a directory.
cmd.plumbing.tree_objekt_erstellen.title: Create a tree object
cmd.plumbing.tree_objekt_erstellen.descr: Creates a new tree object from the current index (staging area).
cmd.plumbing.tree_objekt_aus_text_erzeug: Build a tree object from text
Manually builds a tree object from a textual, ls-tree-like description.
Usually used together with ls-tree/scripts to manipulate tree objects programmatically.
cmd.plumbing.commit_objekt_manuell_erste: Creates a new commit directly from a tree object and one or more parent commits.
Basis for many automation scripts that create commits without a working directory.
cmd.plumbing.referenz_auflosen.title: Resolve a reference
cmd.plumbing.referenz_auflosen.descripti: Resolves a symbolic name (branch, tag, HEAD~2 etc.) to the full SHA-1/SHA-256 hash.
cmd.plumbing.referenz_auflosen.tip: Use --show-toplevel to get the absolute path to the repo's root directory instead.
cmd.plumbing.commit_liste_roh_abfragen.d: Returns a list of commit hashes matching certain filter criteria - the basis of many Git tools.
cmd.plumbing.commit_liste_roh_abfragen.t: Use --count to quickly get the total number of all commits, for example.
cmd.plumbing.index_direkt_manipulieren.d: Modifies the staging area at a low level, e.g. to manually set a timestamp or file mode.
cmd.plumbing.getrackte_dateien_roh_aufli: Lists all files in the index or working directory - the data basis for 'git status'.
cmd.plumbing.anderungen_zwischen_index_u: Compares the staging area at a low level with the last commit (raw form of 'git diff --staged').
cmd.plumbing.anderungen_zwischen_zwei_tr: Compares two tree objects (or commits) with each other at a low level.
cmd.plumbing.symbolische_referenz_lesen_: Reads or sets a symbolic reference such as HEAD, which points to a branch instead of directly to a commit.
cmd.plumbing.referenzen_aller_art_auflis: Shows all branches and tags together with their associated commit hashes.
cmd.plumbing.referenzen_formatiert_aufli: List references with a custom format
Lists branches/tags with a freely chosen, formatted output - ideal for scripts.
cmd.plumbing.gemeinsamen_vorfahren_finde: Determines the nearest common ancestor commit of two branches - the basis of every merge operation.
cmd.plumbing.objekte_zu_paketdatei_bunde: Bundle objects into a pack file
Combines loose objects into a compressed pack file (.pack) - an internal step of 'git gc'.
cmd.plumbing.paketdatei_entpacken.title: Unpack a pack file
cmd.plumbing.paketdatei_entpacken.descri: Unpacks the objects of a .pack file back into individual loose objects.
cmd.plumbing.paketdatei_indizieren.title: Index a pack file
cmd.plumbing.paketdatei_indizieren.descr: Creates the associated index file (.idx) for a received .pack file so Git can access it.
cmd.plumbing.paketdatei_verifizieren.des: Checks a .pack file for structural integrity and completeness.
cmd.plumbing.attribut_einer_datei_prufen: Shows which .gitattributes rules apply to a specific file.
cmd.plumbing.git_umgebungsvariable_abfra: Outputs internal Git configuration values such as author/editor, as used internally by Git scripts.
